short: Another name used to describe magnetic field lines.
long: Another name used to describe magnetic field lines.

short: Concentrated point of magnetic flux.
long: Concentrated point of magnetic flux.

short: Effects of attraction and repulsion by iron and similar materials without the need for an external force.
long: Effects of attraction and repulsion by iron and similar materials without the need for an external force. Electromagnetism includes the effects of a magnetic field associated with an electric current.

short: Ability to produce magnetic lines of force.
long: Ability to produce magnetic lines of force. Measured in units of ampere-turns.

short: Value of a quantity regardless of phase angle.
long: Value of a quantity regardless of phase angle.

short: The pair of leads connecting all of the individual branches in a parallel circuit to the terminals of the applied voltage, VA.
long: The pair of leads connecting all of the individual branches in a parallel circuit to the terminals of the applied voltage, VA. The main line carries the total current, IT, flowing to and from the terminals of the voltage source.

short: The dominant type of charge carrier in a doped semiconductor material.
long: The dominant type of charge carrier in a doped semiconductor material. In an n-type semiconductor free electrons are the majority current carriers whereas in a p-type semiconductor holes are the majority current carriers.

short: Occurs when contacts close and open.
long: Occurs when contacts close and open.

short: The maximum allowable voltage a resistor can safely withstand without internal arcing.
long: The maximum allowable voltage a resistor can safely withstand without internal arcing.

short: Unit of magnetic flux equal to one line of force in the magnetic field.
long: Unit of magnetic flux equal to one line of force in the magnetic field.

short: Metric prefi x for 106.
long: Metric prefi x for 106.

short: The simplest possible closed path within a circuit.
long: The simplest possible closed path within a circuit.

short: Assumed current in a closed path, without any current division, for application of Kirchhoff’s current law.
long: Assumed current in a closed path, without any current division, for application of Kirchhoff’s current law.

short: Resistors made by spraying a thin film of metal onto a ceramic substrate.
long: Resistors made by spraying a thin film of metal onto a ceramic substrate. The metal film is cut in the form of a spiral.

short: Letter symbols used to replace the powers of 10 that are multiples of 3.
long: Letter symbols used to replace the powers of 10 that are multiples of 3.

long: Metric prefi x for 1026.

short: A small unit of capacitance equal to 1 × 1026 F.
long: A small unit of capacitance equal to 1 × 1026 F.

short: A bias point that is centered between cutoff and saturation on the DC load line.
long: A bias point that is centered between cutoff and saturation on the DC load line.

short: Metric prefi x for 1023.
long: Metric prefi x for 1023.

short: A theorem that provides a shortcut for finding the common voltage across any number of parallel branches with different voltage sources.
long: A theorem that provides a shortcut for finding the common voltage across any number of parallel branches with different voltage sources.

short: The type of charge carrier that appears sparsely throughout a doped semiconductor material.
long: The type of charge carrier that appears sparsely throughout a doped semiconductor material. In an n-type semiconductor, holes are the minority current carriers whereas free electrons are the minority current carriers in a p-type semiconductor.

short: Meter-kilogram-second system of units.
long: Meter-kilogram-second system of units.

short: The smallest unit of a compound with the same chemical characteristics.
long: The smallest unit of a compound with the same chemical characteristics.

short: Metal-oxide-semiconductor field effect transistor.
long: Metal-oxide-semiconductor field effect transistor.

short: A device that produces mechanical motion from electric energy.
long: A device that produces mechanical motion from electric energy.

short: A motion that results from the net force of two magnetic fields that can aid or cancel each other.
long: A motion that results from the net force of two magnetic fields that can aid or cancel each other. The direction of the resultant force is always from a stronger field to a weaker field.

short: Resistor in series with a meter movement for voltage ranges.
long: Resistor in series with a meter movement for voltage ranges.

short: Ability of one coil to induce voltage in another coil.
long: Ability of one coil to induce voltage in another coil.
